material_clarifications.title: Freeze allocation choices before the first prospective attempt
material_clarifications.reason: The before-comparison donor/mode cutoff can follow already generated per-arm or construction receipts. The stricter no-restart and no-result-tuning clauses should govern an explicit pre-attempt freeze.
material_clarifications.recommended_action: Seal execution mode, all six donor identities, paired blocks, schedules, and comparison specification at study creation before any prospective qualification, joint attempt, or fit. Treat later donor/mode revisions as separate studies while retaining original terminals and denominators.
